catalogMeta.label: Build an Opinion (open build)
catalogMeta.description: Open build, on the live tutor: for a yes/no question, tap cards into an OREO answer for EITHER side: the opinion first, a reason and an example for that side, the opinion again last. Cards for the other side and an off-topic card are mixed in. Many answers pass. Checked in code from the cards' roles and sides. Beta = oreo + 0.1.

opinions.question: Should kids have daily chores at home?

cards.text: I think kids should do chores at home every day.
Chores teach kids how to be responsible.
Helping out makes family life easier for parents.
Last week, I washed dishes every night, and my mom was very proud.
That is why doing chores daily is good for children.
I think kids should not have daily chores to do.
Kids need time to relax and play after school.
Homework already takes up a lot of free time.
After finishing my math sheet on Tuesday, I was too tired to fold laundry.
So kids should get a break from extra tasks at home.
Giraffes have blue tongues.
Most carrots are orange.

opinions.question: Should students wear uniforms to school?

cards.text: I think kids should wear school uniforms.
Uniforms make getting ready in the morning fast.
Everyone looks the same, so no one gets teased for their clothes.
My cousin puts on her navy polo in two minutes and never worries about outfits.
That is why school uniforms are helpful for students.
I think kids should pick their own clothes for school.
Clothes let students show their unique personality.
Comfortable clothes make sitting in class easier.
Wearing my bright dinosaur shirt always makes me feel happy and creative.
So students should be allowed to choose what they wear.
The ocean covers most of our planet.

opinions.question: Should kids be allowed to bring toys to school?

cards.text: I think kids should bring toys to school.
Toys help children make friends at recess.
Small toys can calm kids down when they feel nervous.
I shared my bouncy ball at lunch, and two new classmates joined my game.
That is why bringing favorite toys to school is a fun idea.
I think kids should leave their toys at home.
Toys can distract students from their schoolwork.
Special toys might get lost or broken on the playground.
A classmate dropped his race car in reading group, and nobody could focus.
So toys should stay safe in a child's bedroom.
Penguins are birds that cannot fly.
